listening.title: Planning meeting with the external auditor

lines.speaker: Chị Thu (Audit Senior)
lines.text: Hi Minh, thanks for meeting us. We'd like to agree on the plan for this year's audit.

lines.speaker: Minh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Sure. Our year-end close should be done by the tenth of January.

lines.speaker: Chị Thu (Audit Senior)
lines.text: Great. Then we can start the audit fieldwork on the fifteenth. I'll send our request list next week.

lines.speaker: Minh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Please do. Last year the list came late, and my team was very busy.

lines.speaker: Chị Thu (Audit Senior)
lines.text: Understood. We'd also like to join your physical count at the warehouse on December thirty-first.

lines.speaker: Minh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: No problem. The count starts at eight a.m. I'll send you the address.

lines.speaker: Chị Thu (Audit Senior)
lines.text: Thank you. For the cut-off test, please keep all delivery notes from late December in one folder.

lines.speaker: Minh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Okay. And should we send the bank confirmation requests, or will you?

lines.speaker: Chị Thu (Audit Senior)
lines.text: We'll send them, but please sign the authorization letters for each bank by Friday.

lines.speaker: Minh (Chief Accountant)
lines.text: Will do. I'll also make sure the fixed asset register is updated before you arrive.
